source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 3, 41. Τὸ ἀναλαβεῖν καρδίας ἐπὶ χειρῶν δοκεῖ δηλοῦν τὸ οἱονεὶ μετὰ χεῖρας λαβόντες τὰς ἑαυτῶν ἐννοίας ἐξετάσωμεν, εἴπερ εἰσὶ καθαραί.
pass_a_gloss: The taking up of kardias epi cheirōn / hearts upon hands seems to show that as if having taken our own thoughts in hand let us examine whether they are pure.
pass_b_english: The taking up of hearts upon hands seems to show that as if having taken our own thoughts in hand let us examine whether they are pure.

choices.why: Pauline echo at Lam 3:48 in Origen’s reading.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.
